newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh wheat consumption expected to rise.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh wheat consumption expected to rise.

text.p: Bangladesh's wheat consumption is expected to rise to 3.6 million tonnes in fiscal 1997/98 beginning July from the current year's 2.9 million, the official BSS news agency said on Wednesday.
The agency, quoting a forecast made in a U.S. Department of Agriculture report, said wheat imports would increase to 2.3 million tonnes in the year from the present 1.55 million.
The report said 1.6 million tonnes might come through commercial imports and the remaining 700,000 tonnes from aid.
The U.S. report said per capita consumption of wheat in Bangladesh could rise to 28 kilos in 1997/98 from 23 kilos currently.
It said U.S. exporters might face tough competition from Australia and other wheat producing countries for a share in Bangladesh's market.
Rice is the staple for Bangladesh's 110 million people.
